name: Ilharg
description: The Raze-Boar, expected bringer of the End-Raze.

timeline.summary: Nikya foretells the Raze-Boar trampling the weak and the city.
timeline.quote: The hooves of the Raze-Boar will trample the weak

citation.text: Nikya of the Old Ways (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri's ascent is seen by some as a sign of Ilharg's return.
timeline.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

citation.text: Rhythm of the Wild (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nikya proclaims the awakening of Ravnica's ancient places at Ilharg's hoofbeats.
